data.body: Rebased exact commit d12389b8d840dee4c10ddd48e7e1801aad7373ee onto current origin/main. make lint and comment hygiene passed. The focused three-suite validation did not pass: test_benchmark_commit_count_is_ceil_per_pass timed out while write_blocking_divergence waited in subprocess.run for git -C <fresh temporary repo> remote get-url origin. This was under concurrent local validation; no code assertion failed before the hang. Per closed bug expectable-slowwitted-squeaker, whose final caveat explicitly excludes fresh-store recurrences from its mature-store auto-maintenance fix, filed lowcost-airsick-marmot (0c8f-1728-6cc9-4c17) and linked it discovered_from this leaf plus relates_to the prior bug. This leaf remains unpushed; I did not retry the unexplained timeout or spend Gerrit CI/LLM resources.
